items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Ben Pollack called me... I was with Pollack a long time.

ctx.x: Well that was decent money back then.

Well as I say this was 19 — early 50s, maybe late 40s with the ‘49 or ‘50 or something. Anyhow so at that period I was doing a few radio shows and then I started to work — Ben Pollack called me. And I always thought, gee, that would be the ideal. You’d have a couple of radio shows, and then you work with a good jazz band in some club at night. And so that finally happened. And after a while I wasn’t too crazy about going to the same place every night and playing the same tunes. You know, even with good guys. So…
This was what, a five or six piece group?
